evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies peer connection management and eviction in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Improves transaction broadcast and network liveness by replacing outbound full-relay peers that decline transaction relay. As noted in the problem statement, outbound slots can currently be monopolized by non-relaying or feefilter-mismatched peers without the operator's knowledge, addressing longstanding issues #16418 and #28371.
